snr.description: Device serial number. Ignored (except for logging) when useMock is true.

isRackSystem.description: Whether the device is a rack-mounted system.

homeOnInit.description: If true, home both axes when the manager initializes.

useMock.description: Force the mock driver (headless testing) regardless of whether pylablib/hardware is present.

driverUnitsPerPositionUnit.description: Conversion factor between ImSwitch position units and the raw values the pylablib driver reports/accepts. Must be non-zero.
